findings.title: New methods use List/Optional annotations
findings.problem: code-quality.md (Types And Imports) says to avoid typing.Optional[X] and List in new code and prefer X | None and list[...]; the new methods get_all_for_user and find_by_id_for_user are annotated List["FeedbackEntry"] and Optional["FeedbackEntry"].
findings.impact: A documented code-quality rule on type annotations is not met for newly added code, which the standards review treats as blocking; no runtime effect.
findings.recommendation: Annotate the new methods as list[FeedbackEntry] and FeedbackEntry | None (quoted forward reference form where needed).

findings.title: Non-admin feedback list silently capped at 10,000
findings.problem: get_all_for_user applies a hard limit(10_000) with no paging or truncation signal, so a user owning more than 10k entries silently loses the oldest ones.
findings.impact: Trigger needs a single user with more than 10,000 feedback entries, which is uncommon; the admin branch uses get_all, whose default page size is also 10,000 on the sibling base class, so the gap is narrow.
findings.recommendation: Accept the cap, or add page/per_page parameters to get_all_for_user and the index route.
